workPackages.title: Cross-tab persistence correctness
workPackages.plan: Do not build another cross-tab store. Rehearsal 6 kept one localStorage record read-merge-written by every tab (src/persistence/Sync.fs:179, main.ts:110 skips exclusion without navigator.locks). localStorage has no compare-and-swap, so no lease on it is correct (both R6 lease trials failed). Arca.Limen already provides one owner per namespace through a Web Lock, a fencing epoch raised by compare-and-put inside an IndexedDB transaction, and refusal of a stale owner's save; without Web Locks it refuses durable ownership. Prove that in a real browser and require Rehearsal 7 to adopt it (D-07 was the deviation that bypassed it).
tests: arca verification/browser/tests/multi-tab-safety.spec.mjs: no Web Locks (three tabs refused durable ownership, nothing written); seeded random three-tab interleavings (enqueue, save, steal, late save from a fenced tab, owner close, reopen) losing no acknowledged key; storage restored into a new context
existing arca limen-queue.spec.mjs: hand-over and fencing
arca MultiTabQueueTests (F#)
acceptance: Zero lost acknowledged saves in every interleaving run
Unsupported coordination fails closed when MemoryOnly is not declared
Independent reviewer reproduces the R6 scenario against Arca and finds no loss
evidence: arca#47 CI at ac585ba: build-and-test, browser (Chromium and WebKit), validate, foundations all green
Local Chromium: 14/14 browser specs; seeds 1-3 covered 31 acknowledged saves, 5 fenced saves, 19 steals, 10 owner closes
workPackages.review: Independent review (agent, not the implementer): R6-D-002 corrected with Web Locks; no loss found, including a concurrent save-versus-steal experiment (6/6). Finding 5: with QueueOptions.standard (MemoryOnly declared) and no Web Locks the queue is per-tab memory-only: no cross-tab loss, but unsent changes do not survive closing the tab, and SaveState does not show durability.
remaining: Merge and release arca#47 (owner): a library fix for Arca's other consumers

workPackages.title: Offline retry and save-state correctness
workPackages.plan: Root cause (R6, verified in code): Limen reports an aborted POST as an unknown outcome while navigator.onLine stays true; reconciliation finds it not landed; the host re-runs synchronization at once (151 POSTs in 60 s, about 5,000 per tab in 5 minutes). Arca's OfflineSync returned an untyped Deferred and left timing to every host. Add to Arca's pure core: typed deferrals, a validated retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter), a schedule that only a provider-confirmed entry resets, and a save state derived from queue and schedule.
tests: SyncScheduleTests: a naive host reproduces the storm (>50 POSTs); the schedule bounds it to <=5 in 60 s; mutation (reset on any progress) gives 76

AdapterScheduleTests: the real GitHubStorage provider over FakeGitHub on a simulated clock: offline (0 writes), lost writes (<=25 write requests in 60 s, never confirmed), 503 and 500 retried as transient, recovery with exactly one ref update, 403 once, 401 once despite edits, repeated online events, lost write then offline
FsCheck properties: delay bounds, monotone ceiling, AwaitApplication never due, confirmed iff synchronized, connectivity idempotence
acceptance: No tight retry loop with the device offline or writes lost
No retry of a permanent or credential failure without the application resolving it
Never 'confirmed' before a provider receipt
Recovery after connectivity returns
Independent verification
workPackages.review: Three independent review rounds. Round 1 BLOCKING (5xx misclassified; repeated online events reset backoff; edits retried a revoked credential; checking-outcome hid waiting-for-connection), fixed in 2c265c2. Round 2 confirmed three fixes and found 5xx in identity resolution, a ref-update resend burst (N1), connectivity never restored, and the Aborted label, fixed in 3ac5652. Round 3 PASS_WITH_FINDINGS (low): L2 NOT_LANDED code and L3 Online only from provider answers fixed in ac585ba; L1 (up to 36 write requests in the first minute when every ref update fails, decaying; R6 sent 151) documented in the CHANGELOG. The ac585ba fixes have tests but no fourth review.

workPackages.plan: Measured cause: an agent-edited pipeline imported from R5 used a per-commit concurrency group on main (still at build-and-test.yml:39), job-level always() started cancelled runs' jobs, and validation ran twice per push on every branch. Conditor's own template was safe; nothing checked its replacement. Add conditor ci-policy check (CIP-000..008) that fails closed, a tier-3 candidate-acceptance template nothing can cancel, foundations and Praxis validation workflows that run once per ref, and timeouts.
